remind.msg.warm:
Hello {contact}, a gentle reminder that payment for bill {number} ({amount}, {date}) is pending. Please pay by UPI when convenient: {upi}. The bill is attached.
Thank you! — {business}
remind.msg.direct:
Hello {contact}. Payment for bill {number} ({amount}, {date}) has been due for {days} days. Please pay by UPI this week: {upi}. The bill is attached.
— {business}
remind.msg.second:
{contact}, following up once more: {number} ({amount}, {date}) is still unpaid. Let me know if there's any issue. UPI: {upi}. Bill attached again.
Thank you. — {business}

assess.unsupported-export: This bill is an export. This app cannot issue an export bill yet.
assess.unsupported-export.do: Your draft is saved. Ask your accountant to raise this one, or remove the marking if it was set by mistake.
assess.unsupported-sez: This bill is to a SEZ unit. This app cannot issue that yet.
assess.unsupported-sez.do: Your draft is saved. Ask your accountant to raise this one.
assess.unsupported-deemed-export: This is a deemed export. This app cannot issue that yet.
assess.unsupported-deemed-export.do: Your draft is saved. Ask your accountant to raise this one.
assess.unsupported-reverse-charge: Tax on this bill is payable by the customer (reverse charge). This app cannot issue that yet.
assess.unsupported-reverse-charge.do: Your draft is saved. Ask your accountant, or remove the marking.
assess.unsupported-advance-receipt: This is an advance receipt. This app cannot issue that yet.
assess.unsupported-advance-receipt.do: Your draft is saved. Bill when the work is done, or ask your accountant for the receipt.
assess.unsupported-non-gst-supply: This is a non-GST supply (like petrol). This app cannot issue that yet.
assess.unsupported-non-gst-supply.do: Your draft is saved. Ask your accountant to raise this one.
assess.gst-status-unconfirmed: To make the bill right we need to know your GST status first.
assess.gst-status-unconfirmed.do: Open Aap and choose your GST status. Your accountant can tell you in a minute.
assess.composition-tax: Under composition you cannot collect GST on a bill.
assess.composition-tax.do: Remove GST from every line; a bill of supply goes out.
assess.composition-legend: The bill will carry: "composition taxable person, not eligible to collect tax on supplies".
assess.unregistered-no-gst: You are not registered for GST, so no GST is added to this bill.
assess.gst-off-plain-invoice: You switched GST off on this bill: it goes out as a plain invoice.
assess.missing-gstin: Your GSTIN is needed on a GST bill.
assess.missing-seller-state: Your business state is needed to work out the right GST.
assess.missing-place-of-supply: Please confirm which state this supply is for.
assess.missing-place-of-supply.do: Choose the customer's state on the bill.
assess.rate-not-chosen: {n} item(s) have no GST rate chosen, so this bill would charge no GST on them.
assess.rate-not-chosen.do: Choose the rate for each item. If one really is nil-rated, choose 0% so the bill says you meant it.
assess.nil-rated-on-tax-invoice: Every line is nil-rated: such a bill is a bill of supply. Switch GST off for this bill.
assess.self-billing: The customer's GSTIN is your own.
assess.hsn-too-short: {n} item(s) carry a short HSN code: at least {digits} digits are needed.
assess.hsn-too-short.do: Enter the full HSN/SAC code on the item.
assess.hsn-missing: {n} item(s) have no HSN code ({digits} digits are needed). Add it on the item.
assess.b2c-recipient-details: On a bill of ₹{amount} or more to an unregistered customer, their name, address and state are needed.
assess.b2c-recipient-details.do: Add the customer's address and state.
assess.e-invoicing-unscreened: Some GST-registered businesses must create bills through the government e-invoice portal. We could not check this for you.
assess.e-invoicing-unscreened.do: Add your yearly turnover under Aap, or confirm with your accountant that e-invoicing does not apply to you.
assess.e-invoicing-self-declared: You have confirmed that e-invoicing does not apply to your business.
assess.e-invoicing-applicable: At your turnover, bills must go through the government e-invoice portal. This app cannot do that yet.
assess.e-invoicing-applicable.do: Your drafts are saved. Raise these bills through your e-invoice provider or accountant.
assess.irn-window-passed: The bill is older than {days} days: the e-invoice portal will not take it now.
assess.irn-window-passed.do: Date the bill today, or talk to your accountant.
assess.credit-note-unlinked: A credit note needs the bill it corrects.
assess.credit-note-unlinked.do: Open the bill and use 'Reduce the amount'.
assess.credit-note-late: The tax on {number} can no longer be reduced: the last date was {date}.
assess.credit-note-late.do: Talk to your accountant about a credit note without a tax effect.
assess.no-rules-for-date: We have no GST rules for this date.
assess.no-rules-for-date.do: Pick a date from 1 July 2017 on.
assess.no-lines.do: Write at least one thing you did.
